facts.fact: Business in Cameroon states that CAMTEL already operates a Tier III-certified data center in Zamengoe, near Yaounde, as of the article; the certifying body is not named and the article does not say whether it sells to outside customers.

note: Cybastion USD 75m Douala data center is planned, not a fact; ST Digital Douala centre called private, no for-hire statement.
